decision: Keep explicit input admission with an architectural cost exception; pooled native timing qualification remains unresolved.
reason: WP13 requires caller-visible input resource failures before recursive/schema/scalar decoding. Removing admission would lose that behavior. The existing reader lacks an equivalent boundary. This is a required resource-contract extension, not a performance optimization.
gate: The existing 10% default cohort regression budget is not met by pooled per-case median ratios. No samples are omitted or declared invalid.

all_six_pairs_paired_diagnostic.qualification: Diagnostic alternate statistic only. Pair 3 and pair 5 have roughly 26% median differences across the entire harness. Cause is not established; this does not replace the failed pooled gate.

positive_replay_cost: Three further alternating pairs preserve all eight receipts. Seven replay/encode cohorts grow 2.04% to 4.01%; the unchanged short prepared-query row has equal 86 ns medians.
allocation_scope: Rust global allocator instrumentation counts alloc, alloc_zeroed and realloc requested sizes. It excludes foreign allocations, retained bytes and stack usage. Each early rejection has zero calls/bytes in all three processes.
required_followup: Requalify native timing on a controlled host and investigate any stable over-budget case before release performance admission. Keep this new guarded executable as the next feature baseline without erasing the frozen pre-admission baseline.
